write_up: This is a strong executive resume! Your progression from clinic operations to COO at Lakeshore Dental Partners is backed by practice growth, financial results and concrete operating changes. A recruiter can see both the scale you run and what you've changed.

The surgery center line is an excellent model: it gives the financial turnaround and names the payer contracts and scheduling work behind it. Your current role also puts the team, revenue, CEO reporting and board work right up front.

Your resume isn't likely to be the reason you don't get a call back. Add the method behind the shorter patient waits and a little more about the Epic go-live if you can. The competitiveness of each executive opening will still matter.
